dialogue.origin: こんにちは。今日はよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Hello. I look forward to our session today.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Hello, I look forward to it as well.

dialogue.origin: 少し早いですが準備がよろしければスタートしても大丈夫ですか？
dialogue.content: We're a little early, but if you're ready, is it alright to get started?

dialogue.origin: はい、お願いします。
dialogue.content: Yes, please.

dialogue.origin: 相談員です。今日はどのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.content: I'm your counselor. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: 人とのコミュニケ―ションや仕事のことで悩んでいます
dialogue.content: I'm struggling with communication with others and with my work.

dialogue.origin: コミュニケーションや仕事のことでお悩みなんですね。それはしんどいとお感じですよね・・詳しく教えてもらえますか？
dialogue.content: So you're struggling with communication and work. That must be difficult for you. Could you tell me more about it?

dialogue.origin: 目標になかなか達成できなくて
dialogue.content: I'm having trouble achieving my goals.

dialogue.origin: 上司や同僚から目標が高すぎるんじゃないかと言われてしまうのです
dialogue.content: My boss and colleagues say that my goals might be too high.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、それはもどかしいですよね。
dialogue.content: I see, that must be frustrating.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 上司や同僚から高すぎると言われるというのは、実際高いとお感じなのですか？
dialogue.content: When your boss and colleagues say your goals are too high, do you yourself feel that they're too high?

dialogue.origin: 自分ではできると思ってるので
dialogue.content: Because I believe I can do it,

dialogue.origin: 頑張りたいんです
dialogue.content: I want to do my best.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。頑張りたいのに出来ると思っていることを周りから言われたら、悔しいですよね
dialogue.content: I see. It must be frustrating when people say that, especially when you want to do your best and you believe you can achieve it.

dialogue.origin: ちなみにどのような目標をお持ちなのか教えて頂けますか？
dialogue.content: By the way, could you tell me what kind of goals you have?

dialogue.origin: どのようなとは？
dialogue.content: What do you mean by 'what kind'?

dialogue.origin: お仕事に関する目標なのですか？
dialogue.content: Are they work-related goals?

dialogue.origin: そうです
dialogue.content: Yes, they are.

dialogue.origin: お仕事は何をされているのですか？差し支えなければ聞かせてもらえますか？
dialogue.content: What kind of work do you do, if you don’t mind my asking?

dialogue.origin: 営業です
dialogue.content: I'm in sales.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・営業でご自分で掲げた目標なのでしょうか？ノルマ的な事なのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. Are these targets you set for yourself in sales, or are they more like quotas?

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: Well, yes.

dialogue.origin: 両方という事なのですか？
dialogue.content: So it's both?

dialogue.origin: ノルマと言うほどきびしいものではないのですが
dialogue.content: They aren’t strict enough to be called quotas,

dialogue.origin: 営業所単位でノルマはありますので
dialogue.content: but there is a quota for the branch office as a whole.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 少しでも成績を上げたいと思っているのですが
dialogue.content: I want to improve my performance, even if just a little,

dialogue.origin: 上手くいきません
dialogue.content: but it's not going well.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。ノルマってほどでもないにしろ目標に成績が上がらない事に焦りやもどかしさが生まれているという所ですよね
dialogue.content: I see. So even though they aren't strict quotas, you're feeling impatient and frustrated that your performance isn't improving toward your targets. Is that right?

dialogue.origin: とてもしんどいとお感じなんですね
dialogue.content: That must feel very tough for you.

dialogue.origin: はい、あせります
dialogue.content: Yes, I feel anxious.

dialogue.origin: 焦りがあると成績もあがらないし
dialogue.content: And when you feel anxious, it's harder to improve your performance,

dialogue.origin: 周りから、できないと言われるのが辛いです
dialogue.content: It's painful to be told by others that I can't do it.

dialogue.origin: はい。出来ないと言われると余計辛いですよね・・頑張ってるのに・・
dialogue.content: Yes. It's especially painful to hear that when you're trying so hard.

dialogue.origin: 目標が高いと言われた時、どう思われましたか？
dialogue.content: How did you feel when they said your targets were too high?

dialogue.origin: なんでできないんだろうと自暴自棄になります
dialogue.content: I get very discouraged, wondering why I can't do it, and feel like giving up.

dialogue.origin: くやしいです
dialogue.content: It's frustrating.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。頑張ってるのに、成果が出ない、そしてご自分の力量を責めてしまわれたんですね・・
dialogue.content: I understand. You’re working hard but not seeing results, and so you end up blaming your own ability.

dialogue.origin: はい悲しくなります
dialogue.content: Yes, it makes me sad.

dialogue.origin: 悲しいやら悔しいやら、周りから言われると自暴自棄になってしまいますよね
dialogue.content: It's a mix of sadness and frustration, and when people around you say those things, it's understandable that you feel like giving up.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: ちなみに、
dialogue.content: By the way,

dialogue.origin: その周りの人たちとはどのような間柄ですか？
dialogue.content: What is your relationship with those people around you?

dialogue.origin: どのようなとは？
dialogue.content: What do you mean?

dialogue.origin: お仕事の上司以外にもいらっしゃらないのでしょうか・・
dialogue.content: Are there others besides your boss at work?

dialogue.origin: 失礼しました
dialogue.content: My apologies.

dialogue.origin: 同僚の方もいらっしゃりましたね
dialogue.content: You mentioned colleagues as well.

dialogue.origin: 特に上司ですが、先輩にも言われることがあります
dialogue.content: It's mainly my boss, but sometimes my senior colleagues say it too.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・上司、先輩、同僚と、本当に色々周りの人に言われると、悲しくなりますよね・・
dialogue.content: I see. Hearing that from your boss, senior colleagues, and peers—so many people around you—must make you very sad.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: It does.

dialogue.origin: 励ましあえる仲間は居ないのですね？
dialogue.content: Do you have any colleagues who you can encourage each other with?

dialogue.origin: 他の営業所には同期がいますので、ついつい愚痴ってしまいます
dialogue.content: I have peers from my intake year at other branch offices, so I often end up venting to them.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、愚痴れる同期はいるものの他の営業所だと、いつもいつもって訳にはいかないですものね・・
dialogue.content: I see. So while you have peers you can vent to, since they’re at other branch offices, you can't talk to them all the time.

dialogue.origin: とても頑張っておられる様子が伺えます。
dialogue.content: I can tell you’re working very hard.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: そのお仕事は何年前から頑張っておられるんですか？
dialogue.content: How many years have you been working hard at this job?

dialogue.origin: ５年くらいです
dialogue.content: For about five years.

dialogue.origin: 五年も！！頑張っておられるんですね。営業ってコミュニケーションとか大変ですよね・・
dialogue.content: Wow, five years! You’ve been working at it for a long time. Sales can be tough, especially with all the communication involved, can't it?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、お客様はいい方がばかりなのでトラブルはないのですが、会社に戻るのが苦痛です
dialogue.content: That's true. My clients are all very nice, so I don't have any trouble with them, but going back to the office is painful.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。お客様というより、会社の中に何か引っかかりがあるようにも。そこでご自分はこうなりたいんだというどんなことでもいいので何か考えをお持ちでしたら教えてもらえますか？
dialogue.content: I see. It sounds like the issue isn't so much with your clients, but with something inside the company. With that in mind, if you have any thoughts about what you'd like for yourself—anything at all—could you share them with me?

dialogue.origin: こうなりたいですか？
dialogue.content: How I'd like to be?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 仕事はいろいろなお客様に会えるし好きなので続けたいと思っています
dialogue.content: I enjoy my job because I get to meet various clients, so I want to continue doing it.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 素敵な事ですよね
dialogue.content: That’s wonderful.

dialogue.origin: 目標を達成するためにはということでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Do you mean in terms of achieving my targets?

dialogue.origin: それもありましたら教えて欲しいですが、会社に戻ると苦痛との事で、何か抑圧されておられるような感じをうけましたが、いかがですか？
dialogue.content: If you have thoughts on that, I'd like to hear them, but you also mentioned it's painful to return to the office. I got the sense that you might be feeling suppressed in some way. How does that sound to you?

dialogue.origin: 上司や先輩からきつく言われるので次は何とかしないとと思うと委縮してしまうとは感じています
dialogue.content: I do feel that when my boss and senior colleagues are harsh with me, I feel intimidated by the thought that I have to do better next time.

dialogue.origin: のびのび出来たらとは思っています
dialogue.content: I wish I could work more freely and at ease.

dialogue.origin: 萎縮してしまって成績が伸びない感じですね
dialogue.content: So it sounds like feeling intimidated is preventing your performance from improving.

dialogue.origin: はい、少し整理させてもらっていいですか？
dialogue.content: Yes. May I take a moment to summarize?

dialogue.origin: はい、お願いします。
dialogue.content: Yes, please.

dialogue.origin: 五年営業でという難しいお仕事の中、ご本人さんはお客様とも上手くかかわっておられ、楽しく、そしてとても頑張っておられるように感じました
dialogue.content: From what I've heard, in the challenging field of sales, you've been working for five years, you get along well with your clients, you enjoy parts of it, and you are trying very hard.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: だた、成績が伸びない事、先輩や周りからの圧力に焦り、しんどさを感じて、萎縮もされているように、見受けられましたが、いかがですか？
dialogue.content: However, it also seems that you're feeling anxious and stressed because your performance isn't improving and you're feeling pressure from your seniors and colleagues, which is causing you to feel intimidated. Does that sound right?

dialogue.origin: その通りです
dialogue.content: That's exactly right.

dialogue.origin: 元々、営業は信頼関係がとても大事で、
dialogue.content: In sales, building a relationship of trust is very important,

dialogue.origin: 相談者さんはお客さんとは笑顔もあるのではないかと。
dialogue.content: and I imagine you share smiles with your customers.

dialogue.origin: 会社では自分らしくないとお感じではないでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Might you feel that you can’t be yourself at the office?

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: I do.

dialogue.origin: お客さんの為に仕事をしているという信念を最優先にしにくくなってしまわれているのかと思えましたが、いかがでしょう。
dialogue.content: It seems to me that it has become difficult to prioritize your conviction that you are working for your clients. How does that sound to you?

dialogue.origin: はい、そう思いながら頑張ってみます
dialogue.content: Yes, I’ll try to keep that in mind and do my best.

dialogue.origin: つまり、のびのびと自分らしく輝いていて欲しいと思いました。
dialogue.content: In other words, I hope you can work freely and shine as your authentic self.

dialogue.origin: 時間となりました。
dialogue.content: Our time is up.

dialogue.origin: 途中まで読んで返信してしまいました、すみません。
dialogue.content: I'm sorry, I replied after only reading part of your message.

dialogue.origin: いえいえ、周りの声も大事ですが、先ずはご自分を信じて頑張って下さいね。
dialogue.content: Not at all. The opinions of others are important, but first, please believe in yourself and do your best.

dialogue.origin: お客さんの為に仕事をしているという信念を最優先にというところがきました
dialogue.content: The part about prioritizing the conviction that I'm working for my customers really resonated with me.

dialogue.origin: グッと
dialogue.content: It really hit home.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: では終了ボタンを押させていただきますね。
dialogue.content: Alright, I’ll go ahead and press the end button now.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

topic.sub: 上司や先輩からの圧力によるコミュニケーションの悩み
